purpose: Teach: 道中/抜け出し/母校/ためし/ところどころ/道理/平然と/此処

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと旅の道中で道に迷ったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, we got lost on a trip together.
lines.style: Soft, distant opening. Gentle pause between thoughts. Voice warm but looking back—not at her, but through her to that memory. Slow, unhurried pace. Almost conversational with the past.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、お仕事を抜け出しても、家族を大事にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes—Grandpa, you always put family first, even when you sneaked away from work, didn't you?
lines.style: Affectionate, teasing lilt on the question. Warm recognition, slightly mischievous. Addressed directly at him with the softness of someone who's watched him for decades. Gentle fade on the tag question.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんの母校をご家族と訪ねたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, we visited his old school together as a family.
lines.style: Same distant, remembering tone. Clear and steady. The words come slowly, each one placed like a stone in water. No urgency. Just the voice of someone letting memory surface.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ためしに新しい料理に挑戦されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you were always trying new recipes, weren't you? Brave as ever.
lines.style: Warm, admiring without fawning. Gentle surprise in her voice—the delight of remembering something sweet about him. Conversational, intimate. Slight knowing smile on the last phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが田んぼをところどころお手入れされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he would tend the rice paddies here and there, keeping everything in order.
lines.style: Still nostalgic, but with quiet pride now. Slightly firmer—the memory of dutiful work, of care taken. Voice steady and grounded. A small nod behind the words.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、孫に道理を諭してらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you taught our grandchildren about doing what's right, didn't you?
lines.style: Soft approval in her voice. Pride mixed with tenderness. Looking at him with the recognition of someone who's seen him shape the next generation. Warm pause before the question tag.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さんはどんな困難も平然と乗り越えられたぞ
lines.en: Gran, your father overcame every hardship with such calm and grace.
lines.style: Voice quieter now, more reverent. The tone of someone reflecting on a legacy. Each word deliberate. A kind of humble admiration underneath—respect for a strength he witnessed. Slight trailing-off, as if the memory settles him.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、此処の畳を毎日綺麗にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you kept these tatami mats spotless every single day, didn't you? Such care.
lines.style: Voice filled with soft wonder at the small, daily devotion. Not marveling—observing with deep affection. She's remembering his hands, his quiet discipline. Gentle, intimate. The tone of someone who noticed everything he did.
